fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is killed as a frontier experiment. The verified diagonal G19 witness already establishes failure of the frozen linear-natural lift, while checking finitely many row orbits at k=2,3 cannot prove a no-go for an undefined future “coherence” grammar or supply the required non-diagonal mutation.

Proposal 2 is killed. A two-sheet Z2 cosystolic test does not imply coercivity for unrestricted integral chains, and no explicit relative complex, CVP factor, equal-radius target, or inequality converting systole into anchor-energy ratio is given.

Proposal 4 is killed. Full Tanner marginals remain linear and affine-natural, so the G13/G15 signed pseudodistribution mechanism and G32/G37 additive parity remain unaddressed; ordinary unique-neighbor arguments do not apply to unrestricted integral pseudocodewords.

Proposal 5 is killed. For any kernel vector g of the base matrix, the higher Lawrence equations retain the bounded vector (g,-g,0,...), and the proposal confuses homogeneous Graver elements with points in the accepting affine fiber; its r=2 enumeration cannot establish amplification.

Proposal 6 is killed. Chen and shuffle identities are nonlinear, but finite selector-table compilation imposes only linear equations on unrestricted signed selectors, reopening affine mixtures and diagonal embeddings; a degree-two pass would not provide the missing induction.

Proposal 3 has no established Parseval coercivity: integral group algebras contain cancellation and zero-divisor directions, and regular-representation symmetry may recreate the G30 NO/YES isometry. It survives only because a complete depth-two transfer experiment can decisively test the ROADMAP Strategy-2 frontier.

G28 already found lambda<mu for a complete finite-state tile, and G30 found an exact seed isometry. Therefore Proposal 3 must certify strict transfer growth and reject group relabeling isometries, not merely separate named attacks.

G13 and G15 show that affine signed combinations can pass complete linear marginals and hierarchy rows with zero residual. G32 and G37 show compatible parity copies can remain exactly additive despite cross-copy coupling.

Proposal 3 is materially distinct enough for one test: its 3600 multiplication selectors fit the ROADMAP bound D<=4096, and the nonabelian product pushforward is not an orthogonal copy or literal tensor. No finite pass may be promoted to an arbitrary-depth theorem.
